Name: Mirren The Florist - A Yandere (obsessive) NPC - NSFW and SFW
Author: Specialagentjonson
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/BUjDXOL.png[/img]﻿
[font=Verdana][b][u][size=5]Please welcome Mirren the Florist to Pelican Town[/size]

[/u][/b][size=4][b]TW[/b] 
!!!Obsessive Behaviours, Unhealthy Relationships, Stalking, Subtle Abuse, Controlling Behaviour!!!
[u]16+
NSFW IS OBVIOUSLY 18+ AND I WILL BLOCK USERS I FIND OUT ARE MINORS WHO USE THE NSFW VERSION. BEHAVE.[/u][/size][/font]

Mirren fled Zuzu City the year before your arrival and has made himself quite the endearing character. While most of the other bachelors and bachelorettes tend to find him somewhat uncanny, Emily has happily taken him under her kind wings and they spend nearly everyday together. He had resigned himself to a life of romantic solitude, accepting that he cannot handle those feelings like a "normal person". But when the farmer walks into his life, kind and caring, he can't help himself.
He knows it's unhealthy, he knows he shouldn't.
But how can he resist when you give him that smile.


[b]This mod is both intended as a "yandere"-esque and a mildly horror inspired one, the goal is to play into the romantic fantasy but there are moments intended to give you the creeps. You have to be [u]16+[/u] to play this mod, there are innuendos and suggestive lines here and there but nothing explicit. 

Do not let anyone treat you like Mirren treats the farmer, stay safe.
But you're welcome to come indulge in this fantasy for a while.


[size=5][img]https://i.imgur.com/OgBhcuw.png[/img]﻿ Featuring: [img]https://i.imgur.com/OgBhcuw.png[/img]﻿[/size]
[/b][size=5]Two different routes
13 total events across the 2 routes
A flower shop - with 9 unique bouquets
New look for the Cat and Dog
Seasonal and Festival outfits
Year 1 mini-storyline involving Emily and Haley
1000+ lines of Dialogue
6 rare and random phonecalls (+3 NSFW ones if you use NSFW ver.)
10+ Letters
15 secret notes [/size]- (Requires "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25055]Secret note framework[/url]﻿")

[b]!!Config Options!![/b]
Shop Placements!
For any reason, you can switch between the retracted or extended Shop. By default it's the one shown in the mod pictures, also called the extended one. If you need the retracted one for mod compatibility reasons, simply switch "Alternative Shop Location" [b]on[/b] and it will change itself! If you have SKE installed and see it being funky, just switch options and it'll clean itself up without issues.

Pet's have been made easier to fiddle with!
With the new configs, you can now change if you want the replacements to be turned on at all
and which pet color to replace with a drop down menu! By default, all pets will be changed but just go into configs and change it.
If you want your specific pet in the events too, you can still check the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/3892]Step By Step[/url]﻿ guide and follow the first set of instructions.

House Location
There is now a separate optional map for Mirren's house. The entrance to the new map is besides the pink blossom tree. It's recommended to choose the alternative map before starting a new game and not switch mid-game but it won't break anything. It shouldn't break anything anyways but things might look weird.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20290]Cornucopia - more flowers: Expanded flowers[/url]﻿
If you have Cornucopia - more flowers with the expanded flowers then you should have this turned on so Mirren will sell those flowers in his shop. If you have the expanded flowers turned off then turn off this option too.

[/b]
[spoiler]All Flowers, Rhubarb Pie, Maki Rolls[/spoiler]

[b][size=4]Events:[/size]
[/b]Disclaimer: For this mod to work properly you HAVE to adopt either the cat or dog.

These events are suppose to be played in sequence, so if you haven't triggered an earlier one then the next one won't play.

[spoiler][b]Heart Event 2[/b]: Go to the Bus Stop between 6AM and 3PM, after you've adopted either the cat or the dog.
[b]Heart Event 4[/b]: Go to the saloon between 7PM and 12AM.
[b]Heart Event 5[/b]: Go back to your Farm between 9PM and 1AM.
[b]Heart Event 6[/b]: Go into Town between 10AM and 3PM when it's sunny on a Wed, Sat or Sun. Only works during Spring, Summer and Fall.
[b]Heart Event 8[/b]: After you've received a letter from Mirren, go into the Forest between 8PM and 12AM.
[b]Heart Event 10[/b]: After you've received a letter from Mirren, enter his house between 8PM and 12AM. This event needs the bus to be functional to trigger.[/spoiler]
[b][size=4]
Route Split:[/size]
[/b]
[spoiler][b]
Therapy Route 
Heart Event 10.5[/b]: After you've read Mirrens letter, go to the Hospital between 9AM and 3PM.
[b]Heart Event 12 part 1[/b]: Befriend Emily to 6 hearts and upgrade your house to have the nursery room. Wake up in your Farm House, it should trigger automatically.
[b]Part 2[/b]: Go to the Saloon while Emily is there, between 6AM and 6PM.
[b]Part 3[/b]: Go to Emily's house between 9AM and 12PM the following Tuesday.
[b]Heart Event 14[/b] [b]Part 1[/b]: Walk out the door to the Farm between 6AM and 8PM during a rainy or stormy day.
[b]Part 2[/b]: Walk into Town between 6AM and 2AM
[b]Part 3[/b]: Wait at least 7 days, then walk into the Farm House between 8PM and 2AM, if Mirren doesn't show after that event, just sleep and he will reappear.

~~~~

[b]Obsession Route
Heart Event 12[/b]:[b] [/b]Befriend Sam, Sebastia[size=2]n and Abigail to 4 Hearts. Go to the Saloon on a Friday between 7PM and 12AM.
[b]Heart Event 14[/b]: Befriend Emily to 6 hearts, afte[/size]r you've gotten her letter, go to her house between 6PM and 12AM.
[b]Heart Event 14+[/b]:
[b]Part 1[/b]: 2 weeks after the Emily fallout, wake up in the farmhouse and it should trigger automatically.
[b]Part 2[/b]: Go to the Saloon after 6PM
[b]Part 3[/b]: Wake up in the farmhouse the day after part 2.
[b]Part 4[/b]?: Good luck. Just listen to the quests.

[size=4][b]Misc Events
[/b][/size][b]Shoveling Snow:[/b] Requirements - it's winter, it's NOT 1-5th of the month or 21st or 22nd. It has a 10% chance to trigger. [size=2]
Enter the town between 2PM and 7PM after you've seen the 2 heart event.[/size][/spoiler]

[b]Schedule[/b]
[spoiler]
Mirren's schedule is very dynamic and dependant on your friendship with him so this is just a general guideline.

[b]Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri:[/b] 9AM - Working at his shop, 4PM - Hanging out at the Saloon, 1AM - Walking Emily Home, 1:40AM - Heading to bed
[b]Wed:[/b] 7AM - Hanging out in the Forest taking photos, 12PM - In Town taking photos, 5PM -  Hanging out at the Saloon, 1AM - Walking Emily Home, 1:40AM - Heading to bed
[b]Sat:[/b] 7AM - Hanging out in the Forest taking photos, 1PM -  Hanging out at the Saloon, 1AM - Walking Emily Home, 1:40AM - Heading to bed
[b]Summer Sat:[/b] 7AM - Hanging out in the Forest taking photos, 8AM - Goes to the Beach to take more pictures, 6PM -  Hanging out at the Saloon, 1AM - Walking Emily Home, 1:40AM - Heading to bed
[b]Sun:[/b] 6AM - Delivering Flowers to Marnie and Leah in the Forest, 9AM Delivering Flowers to house in Town, 2PM - Delivering Flowers to Robin's house, 5PM - Hanging out at the Saloon, 1AM - Walking Emily Home, 1:40AM - Heading to bed
[b]Rain:[/b] Either at home, the Museum or Saloon, walks Emily home as usual at night.

[b]Winter 22: [/b]9AM - At home, 12:30PM Hanging out in the corner of the Town by the Museum, 11PM - Goes to bed.[/spoiler]
